meta_title: Greater Manchester Plasterers | Expert Plasterers Manchester
meta_description: Greater Manchester Plasterers delivers expert plastering across Manchester and surrounding areas. Fast, reliable service. Free quotes. Call us today.
hero_subhead: From skimming and rendering to bespoke finishes, we deliver flawless results on time and on budget across Greater Manchester.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: Whether it's a small repair or a whole-house renovation, we handle every plastering task with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Plastering & Skimming
services.desc: Fresh plasterboard finishing and wall skim-coating to create smooth, paint-ready surfaces. We work fast without compromising on finish quality.

services.title: Exterior Rendering
services.desc: Durable cement and polymer renders that protect your property and enhance its appearance. Includes sand and dash, silicone, and textured finishes.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of outdated Artex and replacement with modern plasterboard or bespoke finishes. Completed with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Coving & Cornicing
services.desc: Precision installation of decorative coving and cornicing to add character and style. Fully finished and ready for decoration.

services.title: Patch Repairs & Remedial Work
services.desc: Expert repairs to damage, cracks, and damp-affected plasterwork. We diagnose the root cause and deliver lasting solutions.

services.title: Dry Lining & Partition Walls
services.desc: Installation of plasterboard stud walls for new rooms or reconfigured spaces. Sound-insulated and fire-rated options available.

about_pullquote: I started this business on getting the finish right first time, every time.
about_para_1: Greater Manchester Plasterers was founded in 2009 with one goal: to restore plastering's reputation in Manchester. Too many homeowners had been let down by rush jobs and poor finishes. We built our business on attention to detail, fair pricing, and keeping our word. Over 15 years, we've completed over 2000 projects across Radcliffe, Bury, Salford, and central Manchester — from modest repairs to full-scale renovations.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we finish on time, clean up properly, and stand behind every job with a three-year guarantee. We're not the cheapest, but we're transparent about costs and deliver visibly better results. Most of our work now comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals — a testament to the standard we maintain on every site.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had our whole living room replastered after removing Artex. Lads were tidy, worked hard, and the finish is absolutely spot on. Better than we expected. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency repair on a crack that appeared after subsidence work. They came out quickly, diagnosed the problem properly, and sorted it the same week. Really professional outfit. Cheers lads.
reviews.author: Christine D.

reviews.text: Got quotes from three plasterers. These guys were in the middle price-wise but their attention to detail and guarantee swung it for us. Render work on the front looks stunning. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Paul W.
